description: List your scheduled and published social posts (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok) with status, public URL and publish time. Filter by status, platform, request, clip or time window; use date=published with since to find posts that went live after a given moment.

date.description: Which timestamp since/until filter and sort by. Use "published" with since to poll for newly live posts.

requestId.description: Only posts made from this request (24-char hex request ID)

shortId.description: Only posts made from this clip (short ID)

since.description: ISO 8601 lower bound. Applies to scheduledAt, or to publishedAt when date=published

source.description: manual = scheduled by hand from the shorts list; automation = posted by channel automation

status.description: Filter by post status: scheduled (queued), processing (uploading or waiting for the platform), published (live, has url), failed (has error), canceled

until.description: ISO 8601 upper bound (same field as since)

name: list_posts
